conflicts.current: The deepest H100 discount found anywhere in this class, read live and anonymously. NVIDIA H100 NVLink in eu-north1 at USD 0.79 per GPU-hour against USD 4.50 on-demand, which is 17.6 per cent of on-demand, a 5.70 times reduction. The same page at the same moment shows H200 at USD 0.89 in us-central1 against USD 5.40 on-demand (16.5 per cent, 6.07 times), B200 at USD 3.60 in us-central1, and B300 at USD 5.89 in eu-west2 and us-north1. The H100 price had been effective since 9 October 2026 17:01, so it was stable for 13 days at the time of reading.
